title: Tennis Vision 0.6.10 — Android runtime validation

execution.sourceNote: Commits after the production source SHA changed Android instrumentation only; this run exercised the same production code in the isolated audit variant.

environment.type: Android emulator on a GitHub-hosted Linux runner
environment.note: A computer hosted the emulator and instrumentation. No Windows backend, camera server or inference service participated in the Android runtime tests.

artifact.name: android-offline-validation
artifact.note: Paths in this report are relative to the downloaded CI artifact or repository. CI artifact retention applies.

scenarios.verified: Decoded synthetic vertical reversals created wall candidates, stored their history and showed REVIEW without an OUT sound. This does not establish physical wall-contact truth.
Starting a new session cleared all area geometry and retained the previous session history.

Real injected taps and drags selected floor and wall separately; cancelling the second floor step preserved the prior configuration; reopening restored the correct draft. Recreating the Activity cleared temporary areas.

Android MediaCodec decoded 191 known synthetic frames. The production detector emitted IN, OUT, REVIEW in order, with exactly three new persisted events, evidence images and one accepted OUT playback request.
With no active network and verified framework battery saver, the screen became noninteractive and then resumed. Settings stayed equal, training returned paused and battery saver remained enabled.
Area setup, invalid tiny selection, cancel, background/resume, ten rapid start/stop taps and Activity recreation completed; preferences persisted while temporary area geometry cleared on recreation.
Android filesystem session write/read and backup recovery restored a valid session after an intentionally interrupted JSON write.
Known ball pixels reached a hardware-rendered preview with an observed center within two pixels; preview-only detection created no impact, speed, score or audio.
After revoking CAMERA, the Android permission dialog was accepted and the emulated camera delivered a frame; permission became granted.
After revoking CAMERA, two real system dialog denials preserved the permission-denied state and the app could open Android application settings.

offlineAndLifecycle.preparation: Emulator airplane mode, Wi-Fi/data disabled, modem voice/data unregistered, virtual eth interfaces down; active network absence was asserted, not assumed from commands.
offlineAndLifecycle.frameworkBatteryPreparation: dumpsys battery unplug; status DISCHARGING; level 50. Waited for PowerManager mIsPowered=false and sticky ACTION_BATTERY_CHANGED fields, then enabled saver and asserted PowerManager.isPowerSaveMode.
offlineAndLifecycle.cleanup: Battery simulation and battery saver reset in finally.

syntheticPipeline.source: Synthetic H.264 MP4 decoded by Android MediaCodec
syntheticPipeline.limitations: Detector-call times on an emulator and synthetic small frames. They exclude full capture/render latency and do not measure a phone, tennis serve speed or physical IN/OUT accuracy. SoundPool acceptance does not prove audible sound; this emulator used -noaudio.

emulatedCameraSnapshot.limitations: One runtime metrics snapshot of an emulated camera, not a sustained benchmark. These rates and delays are not measurements of an S25 Ultra or iPhone.

screenshotsReviewed.observation: IN, OUT, REVIEW and estimated speeds are legible without overlapping labels; leader lines preserve each original contact-ring position.
After wake, the camera preview is visible and the app offers Iniciar treino, matching the paused-state assertion.
The contour surrounds the known synthetic ball without hiding its center; training remains stopped.
The floor polygon and floor boundary remain visible after switching to wall, cancelling and restoring floor.
Separate wall candidate circles and nonoverlapping REVIEW/speed labels are visible.

screenshotNameNote: Names containing 0.6.9 are historical test fixture names; the executed source and app version are identified above.

earlierFailuresAndFixes.issues: A delayed camera frame replaced the editor draft with stale geometry; offline precondition failed; Gradle UTP uninstalled packages before permission checks and evidence collection.
earlierFailuresAndFixes.resolution: Production area-reference guards were added on Android/iOS. The harness now waits for settled touch coordinates and uses explicit adb install/instrument to retain audit packages and artifacts.

earlierFailuresAndFixes.issues: The virtual modem registered after startup and recreated a cellular default network despite link-down. Captured impact labels overlapped.
earlierFailuresAndFixes.resolution: Framework airplane mode and emulator modem deregistration made the offline condition explicit; collision-aware label placement was fixed on both platforms and visually rechecked.

earlierFailuresAndFixes.issues: Battery saver did not activate with the initial emulator battery preparation.
earlierFailuresAndFixes.resolution: Prepared DISCHARGING at 50 percent and waited for the actual framework power transition before requesting saver.

earlierFailuresAndFixes.issues: An added harness precondition read BatteryManager HAL capacity, which did not reflect the framework's dumpsys-simulated level.
earlierFailuresAndFixes.resolution: Validated the sticky ACTION_BATTERY_CHANGED status, plug state and level instead; retained the actual PowerManager.isPowerSaveMode assertions. All scenarios then passed in the final run.

notVerified: Physical Android or iPhone installation, camera accuracy, speaker audibility, thermals or battery consumption.
Sustained real-camera 60, 120 or 240 FPS, complete end-to-end latency or performance on the user's hardware.
200 km/h serves, a distant ball across an entire court, physical floor/wall contact ground truth, or real-match IN/OUT accuracy.
A real phone running with a physical computer powered off; this validation ran the standalone Android code offline inside an emulator.
